pages.title: Using a Saddle
pages.text: Hold a saddle and use it on your own stage III to V humanoid dragon to mount. Sneak to dismount once you land.

pages.title: Flight
pages.text: Stages IV and V can fly with you. With room overhead, hold Jump for about a second to take off. Steer as in dragon form.$(br2)Hold Jump to climb or Ice and Fire's dragon descent key to land. Release both to hold altitude while steering.

pages.title: A Humanoid Mech?
pages.text: Use the dragon melee and breath keys. In flight, aim to direct breath. The melee key throws an ice dragon's throwable trident.$(br2)With empty hands, hold Use to raise your dragon's shield. Lightning dragons trained to guard can parry with a longsword.

pages.title: Who Carries Whom?
pages.text: Carry your dragon, let it carry you, or ride piggyback. Set each sex and stage in the config. Faerie's Wish uses the stage III pose for that sex.$(br2)Taking off while carrying your dragon puts you on its back. Attacks switch to piggyback until the move ends.
